text:
{
  "claims": [
    {
      "anchor": "WAL write transactions write content once instead of twice",
      "claim_text": "WAL write transactions write content once instead of twice.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "writing the content once (versus twice for rollback-journal transactions)"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states WAL writes content once versus twice for rollback-journal."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "they are faster than rollback-journal write transactions",
      "claim_text": "WAL write transactions are faster than rollback-journal write transactions.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails", "sub": "Write transactions are very fast since they only involve writing the content once (versus twice for rollback-journal transactions)"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage says write transactions are very fast due to writing once versus twice."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "checkpoints are slower than WAL write transactions",
      "claim_text": "Checkpoints are slower than WAL write transactions.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P6.S4", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states checkpoints are slower than write transactions."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a checkpoint is also slower than a rollback-journal write transaction",
      "claim_text": "A checkpoint is slower than a rollback-journal write transaction.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": false,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P6.S4", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P4.S0", "rel": "entails"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Inference: checkpoint slower than WAL write, WAL write faster than rollback write, so checkpoint slower than rollback write."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "WAL might be about 1% or 2% slower than rollback mode",
      "claim_text": "For read-heavy applications, WAL might be about 1% or 2% slower than rollback mode.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P0.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states WAL might be 1% or 2% slower in read-heavy applications."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "WAL performs worse than rollback mode for transactions over 100 MB in every SQLite version",
      "claim_text": "WAL performs worse than rollback mode for transactions over 100 MB in every SQLite version.",
      "kind": "logic",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [
        {"sid": "P1.S2", "rel": "entails"},
        {"sid": "P1.S5", "rel": "refutes"}
      ],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "P1.S2 says likely faster for >100MB, but P1.S5 says from 3.11.0 WAL works as efficiently, refuting 'every version'."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "Read performance in WAL mode deteriorates as the WAL file grows",
      "claim_text": "Read performance in WAL mode deteriorates as the WAL file grows.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P5.S0", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states read performance deteriorates as WAL file grows."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "for maximum read performance one would checkpoint as often as every COMMIT",
      "claim_text": "For maximum read performance, one would checkpoint as often as every COMMIT.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P7.S1", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states to maximize read performance, run checkpoints frequently, perhaps every COMMIT."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "in the rollback-journal approach a COMMIT happens when the journal is deleted",
      "claim_text": "In the rollback-journal approach, a COMMIT happens when the journal is deleted.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P2.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states COMMIT occurs when rollback journal is deleted."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "in WAL a COMMIT happens when a commit record is appended to the WAL",
      "claim_text": "In WAL, a COMMIT happens when a commit record is appended to the WAL.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S2", "rel": "entails"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states COMMIT occurs when special commit record appended to WAL."
    },
    {
      "anchor": "a WAL commit never has to write to the original database file",
      "claim_text": "A WAL commit never has to write to the original database file.",
      "kind": "direct",
      "sure": true,
      "evidence": [{"sid": "P3.S3", "rel": "entails", "sub": "a COMMIT can happen without ever writing to the original database"}],
      "check": null,
      "reasoning": "Passage states COMMIT can happen without ever writing to original database."
    }
  ]
}
